ChIJ69P6u6jF1EARHk2JyT6dJYY.962bd4221ebf:
I worked with RoApp for about half a year. During that time we ran into serious technical issues that directly impacted the company's operations and finances.

The Viber integration kept disconnecting on its own. Managers would discover it by accident — when they'd go to message clients and see that the channel was down. Client messages, of course, weren't coming through while Viber was disconnected. Over six months there were around 8 such outages.

As a result, we were losing inquiries, conflicts were arising with parents, our reputation and conversion suffered. The business was taking direct financial losses.

The second problem — no sound notifications. Managers weren't getting audio alerts for new messages and couldn't respond to requests promptly. For a company where response speed is critical, that's unacceptable.

I reached out to tech support multiple times. The answers were always the same: "tomorrow," "the day after tomorrow," "next week." The problems went unresolved for months. Meanwhile, they kept telling us the system was working correctly.

We were forced to switch to a different CRM, and all those problems disappeared.

I wasn't asking for any compensation for the financial losses the company suffered due to the failures. I simply asked for a refund for the unused, already-paid advance period. The refund was refused.

The conclusion is simple: never work with this company, don't wait for issues to be resolved — switch systems immediately.
